session_id.note: Conversation id, up to 100 characters in the tool's live schema (tools/list, 2026-11-09), reused across related calls; used for free-tier rate limiting.

mode.note: Set only through the x-parallel-mcp-config connection header, which needs an API key or OAuth sign-in; a keyless call carrying it answers 401, and this route is keyless.

source_policy.note: Set only through the x-parallel-mcp-config connection header, which needs an API key or OAuth sign-in; a keyless call carrying it answers 401, and this route is keyless.

advanced_settings.note: Set only through the x-parallel-mcp-config connection header, which needs an API key or OAuth sign-in; a keyless call carrying it answers 401, and this route is keyless.

model_name.note: The calling model's exact name, up to 100 characters; analytics only, per the tool's live schema (tools/list, 2026-11-09).
